title: One finite etale lift across a finite order thickening
statement: Let $i:S\to T$ be a finite order thickening of schemes [def-sbc-first-order-thickening] and a universal homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism]. For every finite etale $v:V\to S$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], there exist a finite etale $w:W\to T$ and a map $g:V\to W$ such that the square with sides $v,g,i,w$ is cartesian [def-pc-fibre-product].

source.place: Tag 0GS2, lemma-finite-etale-on-proper-over-henselian-pair, complete Noetherian essential-surjectivity paragraph, before algebraization

proof.text: By essential surjectivity of etale base change along $i$, choose an etale $W\to T$ and an isomorphism $e:W\times_T S\simeq V$ over $S$.

source.place: Tag 0GS2, lemma-finite-etale-on-proper-over-henselian-pair, complete Noetherian essential-surjectivity paragraph, before algebraization

proof.text: Put $g=e^{-1}\circ\operatorname{pr}_W$. The compatibility of $e$ over $S$ identifies the square with the chosen pullback square. The map $\operatorname{pr}_S$ is finite, since its composite with $e^{-1}$ is $v$ and finiteness respects isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 0GS2, lemma-finite-etale-on-proper-over-henselian-pair, complete Noetherian essential-surjectivity paragraph, before algebraization

proof.text: Apply finiteness across the finite order thickening to $W\to T$. Its pullback is finite by the preceding step, so $W\to T$ is finite. It was already etale, giving the requested lift.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_thickening_lift {S T : Scheme.{u}} (i : S ⟶ T)
    (hi : IsFiniteOrderThickening i) [IsUniversalHomeomorphism i]
    (V : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ S) :
    ∃ W : (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).Over ⊤ T,
      ∃ g : V.left ⟶ W.left, IsPullback V.hom g i W.hom
